_metadata.description: Deterministic mobile fixture requirements shared by Android and iOS delivery ramps.

requirements.title: Expose deterministic conformance selectors
requirements.description: The fixture exposes stable selectors for state, input, response, route, connectivity, and notification transitions.

validation.notes: The focused UI test proves persistence and explicit connectivity/notification state transitions.

requirements.title: Provide a BAS-compatible mobile smoke flow
requirements.description: The fixture's selector manifest and BAS case provide a deterministic navigate, input, submit, and assertion flow.

validation.notes: The flow uses selector-manifest IDs and does not depend on timing-sensitive or backend state.
